name: 48227 · Detroit, MI
findings: ZIP 48227 (Detroit) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48227 (Detroit) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
